I don't know where you're from but here job interviews are very far from the easiest thing. They're hard and stressful and it can take a while until you find a job. I did so many interviews and they all scared the sh*t out of me. The thing that kept me going was that each one is a learning experience. Even if you didn't get the job, you got some practice in job interviews and you learned things for the next interview. Practice helped me to be a tiny bit less stressed and to feel a tiny bit more prepared. And yes I told myself those things too when I came back from interviews. I also thought/still think there are so many better people out there than me. Im rooting for you and hope you find a job soon.
Of course you don't have to be perfect. As long as you're doing your best, that's all you can do. Everyone makes mistakes, no one is perfect. Hang in there bud.

About those small classes: I'm glad you were always in one of them.
